# 1 isrg-shortlived-rsa-final

ISRG (Let's Encrypt) Subscriber (Server) Certificate for the `shortlived` ACME profile: RSA subscriber key, subject commonName omitted, issued by a Gen Y Issuing CA under the ISRG CP/CPS

Profile `isrg-shortlived-rsa-final`, version 0.2.0.

| Field | Value | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `v3` | 7.1.1 |
| `serialNumber` | Greater than 0. More than 100 bits of output from a CSPRNG, optionally with additional non-random bits. | 7.1 |
| `signature` | `sha256WithRSAEncryption` | 7.1.3.2 |
| `issuer` | See [§1.1](#1.1) |  |
| `validity` | Validity period is at most 576000 seconds (160 hours) | 7.1 |
| `subject` | See [§1.2](#1.2) |  |
| `subjectPublicKeyInfo` | Algorithm: `rsaEncryption`. RSA modulus length is one of: 2048 bits; 3072 bits; 4096 bits. RSA public exponent is 65537 | 7.1.3.1 |
| `extensions` | See [§1.3](#1.3) |  |
| `signatureAlgorithm` | Identical to `signature` |  |
| `signatureValue` | A signature appropriate to the signatureAlgorithm field. |  |

`issuerUniqueID` and `subjectUniqueID` are absent.

<a id="1.1"></a>
## 1.1 Issuer Name

Byte-for-byte identical to the subject field of the Issuing CA.

Attributes appear in the order listed. DER encoding is one of: `issuerDnYR1`; `issuerDnYR2`; `issuerDnYR3`.

| Attribute | Presence | Encoding | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `countryName` | Always | — | `US` |
| `organizationName` | Always | — | `Let's Encrypt` |
| `commonName` | Always | — | Matches `/^YR[1-3]$/` |

No other attributes are present.

<a id="1.2"></a>
## 1.2 Subject Name

Empty: the commonName is omitted and no other attributes are included (Section 7.1.4).

At most 0 RDNs.

No attributes are present.
